# vercel sandbox

Interact with Vercel Sandbox

```
vercel sandbox
```

## Examples

List sandboxes for the current project

```
$ vercel sandbox list
```

Create a sandbox and connect to it

```
$ vercel sandbox create --connect
```

Global options (`--cwd`, `--scope`, `--token`, `--debug`, ...) also apply; see `global-options.md`.
